Work: world discover karo, phir heart se usme doob jao.
Aaj ka shaq, kal ki rukawat.
Win chahiye, lose karna bhi seekho.
"Goal pe nazar rakh."
Focused raho; distraction mehngi padti hai.
Jaisa aap sochte hain, vaise hi aap ban jaate hain.
Words actions, actions habits banti.
Chalte raho. Sab badalta hai.
Soch lo, tum kar sakte ho ya nahi.
"Jo others nahi karte, woh karke woh pao."
"Quality act nahi—habit hai."
Har din ko result se judge mat karo.
Mistakes se darrna nahi; jaldi seekho.
Hard work jeet jata hai agar talent mehnat nahi kare.
Perfection nahi—progress ka strive.
